policies.rule: When current eligibility, goals, task comparability, recipe and affected horizon support adequacy, KEEP/LEARN_ONLY. An optional signal, surplus set, missed low-criticality task, overlap or priority alone creates no necessity. Unknown critical input leads to ASK/HOLD dependent scope.
policies.basis: DECIDED product rule constrained by evidence, not a physiological law

policies.rule: Assess freshness/protocol/context and own longitudinal task response. Joint signals justify concern only relative to required intent, not fixed count/score. Exact reduction efficacy remains uncertain; bounded reversible options require agency and recheck.

Retain planned revision and actual performed work separately; compare concrete dimension. Above-by-extra-set is not higher RIR = more load, not earned progression, reward or compulsory reduction. Adapt only on material future inadequacy supported by reconciled current facts.

Criticality is authorized goal/phase linkage with essential/dispensable task intent. Alone no need. After a concrete availability need, preserve essential full work by move when feasible; allow explicitly accepted smaller supplemental intent instead when low criticality. If linkage not established, ASK not label-based mutation.

Document nonclinical reason, duration, prior state and current eligibility; no automatic old target/debt replacement. R28-14D exact trial R-E20/S-LRE is limited reversible, not approved general return recipe. Unknown ->ASK/HOLD; clinical cause ->CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED.

Only a material new fact after start permits new remaining proposal; preserve executed prefix and current revision; no stale proposal acceptance or same facts reproposal. Select the smallest sufficient accepted remainder change; clinical concern bypasses stability but not clinical human.

Priority ranks defensible tradeoffs after necessity. Balanced uses co-priority dominance, with ASK for material incomparability; adequate familiar preference or equal preservation may produce identical outcomes across priorities.

Use exact conceptual AE Levels0-6; test smaller effects before bigger. Five/six require explicit coupled week/block necessity, not maximal optimization or return label. Witnesses demonstrate control necessity under premises; no efficacy gold.

Event/familiar training status/phase/essential stimuli/recovery must be explicit. Well-trained endurance evidence bounds direction; exact combined taper R-TAPER10K remains limited. No universal percent, race prediction, elite coverage or automatic restore after cancellation.

Pre-authorized reps/load/effort flexibility is execution, not new mutation; stability must allow it. Outside envelope retained as observed and reviewed. Earned next cycle candidate requires comparable task response; exact step is limited trial, not universal progression threshold.
